question: Sitara Devi was a ________ dancer of India.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kathak**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sitara Devi was a Kathak dancer: 
 
• Known for: A renowned Kathak dancer who popularized the classical dance form 
 
• Awards: Received the Padma Shri, Sangeet Natak Akademi Award, Nritya Nipun, and Kalidas Samman 
 
• Performances: Performed at prestigious venues around the world, including the Royal Albert Hall in London and the Carnegie Hall in New York 
 
• Nickname: Known as the "Nritya Samragini", or Empress of Dance 
 
• Other accomplishments: Also an actress and singer, appearing in 52 movies, including Roti, Najma, and Aabroo 
 
• Born: In Kolkata on November 8, 1920 
 
• Died: On November 25, 2014 at Jaslok Hospital
 
• Introduced Kathak to Bollywood: A pioneer who introduced the classical art form to mainstream Bollywood 
 
• Contribution to Kathak: Her performances helped make Kathak a respectable dance form and gain global recognition 
 
• Kathak is a classical dance form that is usually performed solo and focuses on footwork.
 
• It is the only classical dance that is associated with Hindustani or North Indian music. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bharatanatyam
 
• A classical dance from Tamil Nadu, India. It expresses Hindu and Jain spiritual ideas and South Indian religious themes.
 
• Bharatanatyam is known for its strong lines, hand gestures, and facial expressions. 
 
• Kathakali
 
• A classical dance from Kerala, India. It involves storytelling through footwork, hand gestures, and facial expressions, accompanied by music and vocal performance
 
• Kuchipudi
 
• A classical dance from Andhra Pradesh, India. The name Kuchipudi comes from a village in the Krishna district of Andhra Pradesh
